hints.title: Distinct Array Property
hints.text: All elements in the array are distinct. The lexicographically largest subarray of length k is determined entirely by its first element.

hints.title: Valid Starting Index Range
hints.text: Any valid subarray of length k must start at an index between 0 and len(nums) - k inclusive.

hints.title: Finding Maximum Leading Element
hints.text: Find the index of the maximum value within nums[0..len(nums) - k] and return the k elements starting from that index.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass scanning valid starting indices in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing all candidate subarrays of length k element-by-element takes O(N * k) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Distinct elements guarantee the first element alone determines lexicographical superiority.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Greedy choice of maximum starting element within the valid boundary.
